title: EmailFilterCondition and EmailComparator missing Eq derive
description: In crate-jmap-mail-types/src/query.rs: EmailFilterCondition (line 26) derives PartialEq but not Eq. All its fields are Eq: Option<Id> (Id is Eq), Option<UTCDate> (UTCDate is Eq), Option<u64>, Option<String>, Option<bool>. EmailComparator (line 131) similarly derives PartialEq but not Eq; its fields String, bool, Option<String> are all Eq. Both types could and should derive Eq. Note: EmailSubmissionFilterCondition in submission.rs (line 290) correctly derives Eq — these two are inconsistent with it. The missing Eq prevents using these types in contexts that require Eq (HashMap keys when wrapped, certain trait bounds in generic code).
